styleLockTemplate: [medium + lineage], [line quality], [shading model], [lighting logic], [palette + colour script], [level of detail], [framing], [finish rules], no text, no lettering, no speech bubbles
styleLockExample: korean dark fantasy webtoon, intricate varied-weight ink lineart, painterly chiaroscuro shading, ember and moonlit rim lighting, gothic korean architecture, atmospheric depth haze, muted jewel palette of jade, ink-black and old gold, vertical 800x1280 panel, cinematic graphic composition, no text
styleLockRules: No character descriptions inside the lock
No negations inside the lock — use the negative prompt
Include 'no text, no lettering, no speech bubbles'
faceAnchorExample: Han Yuwol, 34-year-old korean man, long high-cheekboned face, tired narrow eyes with faint dark circles, straight brows, straight black hair slightly too long at the nape, tall lean build, ink-stained fingers
faceAnchorRules: Permanent identity only: skull shape, eyes, brows, hair silhouette, build, scars
Never include clothing, armour, props, emotion, lighting or pose
Pasted verbatim into every panel that features this character
Outfit lives in its own field and in per-panel overrides
outfitTemplate: [garment layers], [colour and material], [one distinctive detail], [state: dry/soaked/torn/bloodied]
referenceSheetPrompt: character reference sheet, front / three-quarter / profile views, {{anchor}}, neutral grey background, {{styleLock}}, consistent design

referenceSheetShots.portrait: head and shoulders, neutral expression, front view
referenceSheetShots.fullBody: full body, front view, neutral stance, feet visible
referenceSheetShots.turnaround: front, three-quarter, profile and back views side by side
referenceSheetShots.expressions: six small heads: neutral, angry, shocked, smiling, determined, pained
referenceSheetShots.poses: six full-body poses: standing, running, attacking, blocking, falling, reaching

referenceAttachmentLine: use the attached reference sheets as the visual reference; keep face shape, eye design, hair silhouette and costume identical
characterAnchorTemplate: [name], [age]-year-old [nationality] [gender], [face: eyes, nose, brows], [hair], [build], [outfit with one distinctive detail], [prop], [palette]
characterAnchorExample: Han Yuwol, 34-year-old korean man, tired narrow eyes with faint dark circles, straight black hair slightly too long at the nape, tall lean build, charcoal ferryman's long coat worn open, chipped jade badge on the left lapel, ink-stained fingers, carries a warm paper lantern at hip height
characterAnchorRules: Only permanent features: bone structure, hair, clothes, props
Never include emotion, lighting or pose
Paste verbatim in every panel; never paraphrase
panelPromptTemplate: {{styleLock}}, {{shot}}, {{angle}}, {{composition}}, {{setting}}, {{action}}, {{characterAnchors}}, {{lighting}}, {{palette}} colour script, {{framing}}, identical facial structure and outfit to the character reference sheet
negativePrompt: blurry lineart, extra fingers, extra limbs, deformed hands, watermark, signature, garbled text, latin lettering, speech bubbles, photorealistic, 3d render, anime screencap, oversaturated pastel, chibi, cropped head, duplicate character, inconsistent eye colour, modern clothing

negativeAdditions.crowd: two heads, fused bodies, melted faces

seedPolicy: one seed per episode; re-roll only character sheets; change one variable per iteration

shotPhrases.establishing: establishing shot, environment dominant, figure small in frame
shotPhrases.wide: wide shot, full bodies, clear blocking and spatial geography
shotPhrases.full: full-body shot, figure fills the vertical frame
shotPhrases.medium-close: medium close-up, chest up, hands visible
shotPhrases.close-up: close-up on the face, emotion legible at thumbnail size
shotPhrases.extreme-close: extreme close-up, single detail fills the frame
shotPhrases.insert: insert shot, object detail, shallow depth of field
shotPhrases.over-shoulder: over-the-shoulder shot, foreground shoulder in silhouette
shotPhrases.silhouette: silhouette shot, subject backlit and unreadable
shotPhrases.panel-less: panel-less bleeding art, no frame border, full-bleed composition

lightingPhrases.lantern: warm practical lantern key from below, cold blue rim, deep falloff
lightingPhrases.overcast: flat overcast ambient, low contrast, soft shadows
lightingPhrases.neon: magenta and cyan edge lighting, wet reflective surfaces
lightingPhrases.interrogation: hard top light, black background, single specular
lightingPhrases.golden: low golden hour side light, long shadows, warm bounce

letteringNote: Never let the image model render text. Letter in the studio: balloons, tails, captions and SFX are layout, not paint.
